author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 나그네새·겨울철새, 해마다 수천 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 산지와 평지의 숲, 도시 인근 농경지
summary: 전국에서 관찰되는 겨울철새다. 번식기에는 조금 높은 산지나 평지의 숲속에 살고, 그 밖의 때에는 산림과 평지, 도시 가까운 농경지에서도 보인다. 작은 새와 작은 곤충, 다람쥐 등을 먹으며, 잡목림의 4~8m 넘는 높은 가지에 가는 나뭇가지를 접시 모양으로 쌓아 둥지를 짓고 5월 무렵 알 4~5개를 낳는다. 국외에서는 유럽, 아프리카, 러시아, 중국, 일본에 분포한다.

points.en: white underparts barred buff and dark brown (female)

sexes.male: 윗면이 어두운 회색이고 눈 위로 희미한 흰 눈썹선이 있으며, 흰 아랫면에 가는 적갈색 가로줄이 있다.
sexes.female: 전체적으로 갈색이고 눈 주위가 검다. 턱 밑과 그 아래는 흰 바탕에 어두운 갈색 반점이 있고, 나머지 흰 아랫면에는 황갈색과 어두운 갈색 가로띠가 있다.

art.subject: Eurasian Sparrowhawk (Accipiter nisus), adult male, as seen around Korean woods and farmland from October to March: crown, nape, back, upperwings and tail dark blue-grey; a faint, short white supercilium above and behind the eye; cheeks and ear-coverts orange-rufous; throat whitish with fine dark streaks. Breast, belly and flanks white, densely crossed with fine orange-rufous bars, the rufous often washing the flanks; undertail coverts white. Tail with several darker bands. Iris orange; cere yellow; bill short, dark and hooked; legs long, very thin, yellow, with a long slender middle toe.
art.pose: perched on a branch in woodland, side view
art.scene: Korean winter farmland edge: bare trees beside fields near a wooded hill; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: dark blue-grey upperparts, faint short white supercilium, orange-rufous cheeks, white underparts finely barred orange-rufous, orange eye, thin yellow legs, long barred tail

adult female, side view perched: grey-brown upperparts, distinct white supercilium over a dark eye-stripe and dark ear-coverts, white throat spotted dark brown, white underparts barred dark brown with a buff tinge, yellow eye, long barred tail
art.build: Small hawk; the male about the length of a Feral Pigeon, the female noticeably larger. Small rounded head with a flat, fierce brow; slender build. Wings short and rounded with deeply fingered tips; at rest the wingtips fall far short of the tail tip. Tail long, narrow and square-cornered. Legs long and pencil-thin. Flight a few quick flaps and a glide, low along hedges and woodland edges, surprising small birds.
avoid: Do not paint the male with a broad white supercilium and heavy black mask — that is Eurasian Goshawk, which is also far larger and bulkier.
Do not paint streaked underparts; adults are barred across.
Do not paint a swollen orange cere or black wingtips on a pale underwing (Chinese Sparrowhawk).
Do not paint thick legs or a short tail.
